mapper.insert: INSERT INTO balances (account_id, currency, available_amount, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{currency}, #{availableAmount}, #{version}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT account_id, currency, available_amount, version, created_at, updated_at FROM balances WHERE account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY currency
SELECT account_id, currency, available_amount, version, created_at, updated_at FROM balances WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND currency = #{currency} FOR UPDATE
